tested_claim: Weak, medium and strong relationship settings differ mainly through plot-level scheduling rather than macro crop allocation or expected return.
perturbation: Relationship coefficient levels 0.15, 0.35 and 0.55; all plans evaluated on the same medium correlated scenarios.
interpretation: 宏观策略稳健、地块调度灵活；低逐地块重合度主要来自等价解的微观平移。
limitation: The result is conditional on the simulated relationship edges, strengths and medium correlated evaluation scenarios; it is not evidence of real causal elasticities.
fallback_trigger_relevance: Q3-F1 is not observed after replacing the plot-level overlap diagnostic with the predeclared macro profit and crop-area criteria.
